enums.Definitions.Cabin: The ticketed cabin: BasicEconomy, MainCabin, MainPlus, PremiumEconomy, Business, or First.
enums.Definitions.City: The named origin or destination city. Choose the matching city constructor from the closed 73-city itinerary gazetteer.
enums.Definitions.EliteStatus: The passenger's AAdvantage or equivalent oneworld tier at the stated time: NoStatus, Gold, Platinum, PlatinumPro, or ExecutivePlatinum.
enums.Definitions.ItemKind: The kind of carried item: OrdinaryBag, SoftSidedGarmentBag, DiaperBag, BreastPump, BreastMilkCooler, ChildSafetySeat, Stroller, or MedicalOrMobilityDevice.
enums.Definitions.MilitaryStatus: The passenger's U.S. military travel category: NotMilitary, OnOrders, or PersonalTravel.

itinerary.description: The passenger's complete itinerary and baggage facts used to calculate total trip cost.

itinerary.cabin.description: The cabin in which the passenger is ticketed.

itinerary.cardmember.description: Whether the passenger is an eligible AAdvantage Aviator or Citi/AAdvantage cardmember.

itinerary.children.description: The nonnegative number of children travelling with the passenger, used for the one-diaper-bag-per-child allowance.

itinerary.flagship.description: Whether the passenger has a confirmed Flagship First or Flagship Business Plus fare product.

itinerary.items.description: The ordered list of items the passenger presents; order determines checked-bag position and fees.

itinerary.items[].height.description: The item's nonnegative height in inches.

itinerary.items[].kind.description: The item's baggage or exempt-item category.

itinerary.items[].length.description: The item's nonnegative length in inches.

itinerary.items[].weight.description: The item's nonnegative weight in pounds.

itinerary.items[].width.description: The item's nonnegative width in inches.

itinerary.military.description: The passenger's U.S. military travel status, including whether travel is on orders or personal.

itinerary.status_at_checkin.description: The passenger's AAdvantage or equivalent oneworld elite status at check-in.

itinerary.status_at_ticketing.description: The passenger's AAdvantage or equivalent oneworld elite status at ticketing.

itinerary.ticket.description: The nonnegative base ticket price as a monetary amount, before baggage fees.

structs.Definitions.Item: One carried item, recording its kind, dimensions in inches, and weight in pounds.
structs.Definitions.Itinerary: A passenger itinerary containing route, cabin, ticket price, ordered items, benefit statuses, and child count.
